match.predicted_risk_point_title: The risk point title predicted by the model, used to locate the corresponding text in the model output.
match.matched_true_label_risk_point_title: The risk point title from the true label (third-party output), used to locate the corresponding text.
match.match_reason: Reason for matching these two risk points, including the original clause text.
match.risk_description_direction_consistency_r: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk description direction matches the true label's risk description direction.
match.risk_description_content_accuracy_reason: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk description content is accurate compared to the true label's risk description.
match.risk_suggestion_direction_consistency_re: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk suggestion direction matches the true label's suggestion direction.
match.risk_suggestion_content_accuracy_reason: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk suggestion content is accurate compared to the true label's suggestion content.
match.risk_suggestion_content_completeness_rea: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk suggestion content is complete.
match.risk_modification_direction_consistency_: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk modification direction matches the true label's modification direction.
match.risk_modification_content_accuracy_reaso: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk modification content is accurate compared to the true label's modification content.
match.risk_modification_content_completeness_r: Reason for determining whether the model's predicted risk modification content is complete.
